Thank you for your application to drive for {1}. At {2} years old, you're at a crucial stage in any racing driver's career development.

If you can prove yourself in the junior formulas over the next few years, and if you show the results and maturity we're looking for, then we might very well be having a different conversation when you turn 18.
The door isn't closed - it's just not open yet. Make the most of these crucial years.
Best of luck with your racing career,
